The final tests passed, and the mutation logs show the expected failures. The remaining Clippy and check builds are still running through mbx; the lane source has no unrelated changes.

Final Clippy and the three-crate check passed. I’ve written the lane report with file locations, test assertions, and mutation evidence; I’m waiting for the last formatter check before handing it back.
